source: model-staffing Q1 (coordinator freeze): model-market base id (before the ::<effort> suffix) -> CPA catalog id. The CPA ids mirror the alias spellings in roles/model-tiers.json (the benchmarked families). This repo seed is the DEFAULT; the shared override at ~/.agenthop/swarm/roles/model-market-map.json takes precedence. A model-market model with no entry here (and none in the override) is SKIPPED by pickModel and COUNTED (unmappableCount, Q1 visible).
note: Keys are model-market BASE ids (e.g. claude-opus-5.5, not claude-opus-5.5::max) — all reasoning-effort variants of a family resolve through one entry. Values are CPA catalog ids. Updating this is a ruling, not a code change; extend via the shared override file without a redeploy.
